overview.description: The Nightview Fund ETF (NITE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of US equity securities. The fund aims for long-term capital appreciation while attempting to beat the S&P 500 over five years. NITE was launched on Jun 21, 2024 and is issued by The Nightview.
